items.source: An implementation of both a Schema as well as a Neo4j version of Spring Data's MappingContext.
items.translation: 实现了 Schema 以及 Spring Data 的 Neo4j 版本中 MappingContext。

items.source: A PersistentEntity interface with additional methods for metadata related to Neo4j.
items.translation: 一个 PersistentEntity 接口，并添加了与 Neo4j 相关的元数据方法。

items.source: A PersistentProperty interface with additional methods for metadata related to Neo4j.
items.translation: 一个 PersistentProperty 接口，并增加了与 Neo4j 相关的元数据方法。

items.source: Wrapper class for property paths and information if they point to an entity.
items.translation: 用于属性路径和指向实体的信息的包装类。

items.source: A very loose coupling between a dot path and its (possible) owning type.
items.translation: 点路径与其（可能的）所属类型之间的非常松散的耦合。

items.source: Warning Internal API, might change without further notice, even in patch releases.
items.translation: 警告 内部 API，可能会在未另行通知的情况下发生变更，即使是在补丁版本中。

items.source: Describes how a class is mapped to a node inside the database.
items.translation: 描述类如何映射到数据库中的节点。

items.translation: 版权所有 © 2019–2026 Neo4j、Neo4j Sweden AB。保留所有权利。

items.source: An instance of such a provider can be registered as a Spring bean and will be consulted by the Neo4jMappingContext prior to creating and populating persistent properties.
items.translation: 此类提供者的实例可注册为 Spring Bean，在创建并填充 Neo4jMappingContext 的 持久化属性 之前，该上下文将咨询此类提供者。

items.source: The CreateRelationshipStatementHolder holds the Cypher Statement to create a relationship as well as the optional properties that describe the relationship in case of more than a simple relationship.
items.translation: CreateRelationshipStatementHolder 持有用于创建关系的 Cypher 语句，以及在关系不止为简单关系时，描述该关系的可选属性。

items.source: A builder for creating custom instances of a Neo4jMappingContext.
items.translation: 一个用于创建Neo4jMappingContext自定义实例的构建器。

items.source: The characteristics of a Neo4jPersistentProperty can diverge from what is by default derived from the annotated classes.
items.translation: Neo4jPersistentProperty 的特性可能与从注解类中默认推导出的特性有所不同。

items.source:
This package contains configuration related support classes that
can be used for application specific, annotated configuration classes.
items.translation: 该包包含与配置相关的支持类，可用于针对特定应用程序的注解式配置类。

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Provides a set of simples types that SDN supports.
items.translation: 提供了一组 SDN 支持的简单类型。

items.source: The main mapping framework.
items.translation: 主要映射框架。

items.source: This package contains the callback API.
items.translation: 该包包含回调 API。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库基类。

items.source: A generator based on the schema defined by node and relationship descriptions.
items.translation: 基于节点和关系描述所定义的架构的生成器。

items.source:
Used to keep the raw result around in case of a DTO based projection so that missing
properties can be filled later on.
items.translation: 用于保留原始结果，以便在基于 DTO 的投影中稍后填充缺失的属性。

items.source:
Provides minimal information how to map class attributes to the properties of a node or
a relationship.
items.translation: 提供有关如何将类属性映射到节点或关系的属性的最少信息。

items.source: Description how to generate Ids for entities.
items.translation: 描述如何为实体生成 ID。

items.source:
Class that defines a tuple of relationship with properties and the connected target
entity.
items.translation: 定义具有属性及连接目标实体的关系元组的类。

items.source: This orchestrates the built-in store conversions and any additional Spring converters.
items.translation: 该配置协调内置的存储转换以及任何额外的 Spring 转换器。

items.source: Working on nested relationships happens in a certain algorithmic context.
items.translation: 嵌套关系的操作发生在特定的算法上下文中。

items.source: Valid processing states.
items.translation: 有效的处理状态。

items.source: Reactive Supplier for arbitrary relationship ids.
items.translation: 针对任意关系 ID 的反应式供应商。

items.source: Supplier for arbitrary relationship ids.
items.translation: 任意关系 ID 的供应商。

items.source:
Something that makes sense of propertyPaths by having an understanding of projection
classes.
items.translation: 通过理解投影类来赋予 propertyPaths 意义的机制。

items.source: Description of a relationship.
items.translation: 关系描述。

items.source:
Contains the descriptions of all nodes, their properties and relationships known to
SDN.
items.translation: 包含 SDN 已知的所有节点、其属性及关系的描述。
